lessons.title: Voz pasiva
lessons.goal: Cuenta qué se hizo sin decir quién lo hizo
tip: be + participio: The letter was sent. These cars are made in Japan.
Se usa cuando el agente es obvio, desconocido o poco importante.
«By» solo si necesitas mencionar al agente: written by Orwell.

phrases.es: Estos coches se fabrican en Japón
phrases.en: These cars are made in Japan

exercises.prompt: Traduce: «Estos teléfonos se fabrican en China»
exercises.solution: These phones are made in China

pair.es: estos teléfonos se fabrican en china
pair.en: these phones are made in china

exercises.audio: The results will be published tomorrow.
options: Los resultados se están publicando ahora.

exercises.prompt: Cada mañana limpian la habitación (rutina). The room ___ cleaned every morning.

lessons.title: Estilo indirecto
lessons.goal: Cuenta lo que otra persona dijo
tip: say + lo que se dice; tell + a quién: He told me… / He said that…
Backshift: am → was, will → would, can → could, have done → had done.
Cambian las referencias: today → that day, tomorrow → the next day.

phrases.es: Me contó que había vivido en Canadá
phrases.en: She told me she had lived in Canada
They said they would come later

exercises.solution: He said he would arrive soon

pair.en: he said he would arrive soon

exercises.audio: She told me she had finished the report.
options: Me dijo que había terminado el informe.
Me dijo que terminaría el informe.
Me dijo que está terminando el informe.

exercises.prompt: «I am happy» → He said he ___ happy.
exercises.explain: Presente → pasado en el estilo indirecto.

lessons.title: Tercera condicional
lessons.goal: Expresa arrepentimientos y críticas sobre el pasado
tip: If + had + participio, would have + participio.
If I had studied, I would have passed = Si hubiera estudiado, habría aprobado.
Negativo: If we hadn't left late… (si no hubiéramos salido tarde…).

phrases.en: If I had studied, I would have passed

phrases.es: Si no hubiéramos salido tarde, no habríamos perdido el tren
phrases.en: If we hadn't left late, we wouldn't have missed the train

exercises.sentence: If I ___ known, I would have helped.

exercises.prompt: If we had left earlier, we ___ the train.
Traduce: «Si hubiera sabido la respuesta, te la habría dicho»
exercises.solution: If I had known the answer I would have told you

exercises.audio: If she had studied more, she would have passed.
options: Si hubiera estudiado más, habría aprobado.
Estudió más y por eso aprobó.

lessons.title: Expresiones de negocios y noticias
lessons.goal: Entiende titulares y habla de decisiones de empresa
tip: put off = posponer; come up with = ocurrírsele (una idea); look into = investigar.
bring up = sacar un tema; carry out = llevar a cabo; break out = estallar (una guerra).

phrases.en: We are going to put off the meeting
